messages:
maria: quick check — PR #27891 (small perf tweak) is green locally but CI queue shows ~70 pending jobs. thinking we should hold until the rebase window tonight to avoid risking deploy freeze. @alex @sam any objections?

alex: I agree hold. We're expecting a deploy blackout at 00:00 UTC. If it's urgent we can land to a canary region instead.

sam: what's the ETA on the CI backlog? last I saw it was ~2h.

ci-bot: Queue status — 68 pending jobs, median runtime 14m, estimated queue delay ~3h. https://ci.local/queue/659001

jen: If we delay, can we at least rebase now so it's ready to merge once queue clears? there might be a small conflict with the db-migration PR.

maria: yes I can rebase now. planning to run `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main` and then push --force after local checks.

sam: ping me after push, i'll eyeball the canary plan and watch the queue.

alex: if you rebase, mark the PR with a canary rollout note and don't auto-rollout during the blackout: `/rollout canary pr-27891 eur-1`

patrick: +1 to rebase now and queue for post-freeze merge. also please add a short rollback plan in the PR description.

maria: done — rebased and pushed (force) at 6590012450. CI re-triggered.

maria: CI kicked off for the PR again. ci-bot status?

ci-bot: Build started: pr-27891 (job 44211). current position in queue: 21. ETA ~5m to start.

alex: :thumbsup: will follow up on canary gating tomorrow morning.

sam: thanks — lgtm pending green CI.

jen: leaving a comment on the PR noting the blackout window and rollback steps.

maria: OK thanks all — will wait for green and then request merge-window approval.
